name: proton-drive-mcp
description: MCP server and CLI that gives Claude full access to Proton Drive — upload, download, share, and manage your end-to-end encrypted files without leaving the conversation.

tools.name: drive_auth_status
tools.description: Check whether the Proton Drive CLI is authenticated.

tools.name: drive_auth_logout
tools.description: Log out of Proton Drive (clears stored session).

tools.name: drive_version
tools.description: Get Proton Drive CLI and SDK version information.

tools.name: drive_list
tools.description: List files and folders at a Proton Drive path.

tools.name: drive_upload
tools.description: Upload a local file or folder to Proton Drive.

tools.name: drive_download
tools.description: Download a file or folder from Proton Drive to a local path.

tools.name: drive_mkdir
tools.description: Create a new empty folder on Proton Drive.

tools.name: drive_move
tools.description: Move or rename a file or folder on Proton Drive.

tools.name: drive_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete a file or folder from Proton Drive.

tools.name: drive_share_status
tools.description: Get sharing status and member list for a Proton Drive path.

tools.name: drive_share_invite
tools.description: Invite someone to access a Proton Drive file or folder.

tools.name: drive_share_revoke
tools.description: Remove someone's access to a Proton Drive file or folder.

tools.name: drive_trash
tools.description: Move a file or folder to trash on Proton Drive.

tools.name: drive_restore
tools.description: Restore a file or folder from trash on Proton Drive.

tools.name: drive_list_trash
tools.description: List files and folders currently in the Proton Drive trash.

tools.name: drive_empty_trash
tools.description: Permanently delete ALL items in the Proton Drive trash.

tools.name: drive_read_file
tools.description: Read the text contents of a file from the local Proton Drive sync folder (requires PROTON_DRIVE_SYNC_PATH).

tools.name: drive_write_file
tools.description: Write text content to a file in the local Proton Drive sync folder (requires PROTON_DRIVE_SYNC_PATH).

tools.name: drive_copy
tools.description: Copy a file or folder to another location on Proton Drive without removing the original.

tools.name: drive_list_invitations
tools.description: List all pending sharing invitations received from other Proton Drive users.

tools.name: drive_invitation_accept
tools.description: Accept a pending Proton Drive sharing invitation by uid.

tools.name: drive_invitation_reject
tools.description: Reject a pending Proton Drive sharing invitation by uid.

tools.name: drive_share_leave
tools.description: Leave a Proton Drive folder that was shared with you by another user.

tools.name: photos_list_albums
tools.description: List all photo albums in Proton Photos.

tools.name: photos_create_album
tools.description: Create a new empty photo album in Proton Photos.

tools.name: photos_delete_album
tools.description: Delete a Proton Photos album.

tools.name: photos_list_album_photos
tools.description: List the photos in a Proton Photos album.

tools.name: photos_add_to_album
tools.description: Add a photo from your Proton Photos library to an album.

tools.name: photos_remove_from_album
tools.description: Remove a photo from a Proton Photos album.

tools.name: drive_share_set_url
tools.description: Create or update a public share link for a Proton Drive file or folder.

tools.name: drive_share_remove_url
tools.description: Remove the public share link from a Proton Drive file or folder.

tools.name: drive_share_remove_all
tools.description: Remove all members and pending invitations from a shared Proton Drive path in one call.

tools.name: photos_update_album
tools.description: Rename an album or change its cover photo in Proton Photos.

tools.name: photos_list_timeline
tools.description: List photos in your Proton Photos timeline.

tools.name: photos_download
tools.description: Download one or more photos from Proton Photos to a local folder.

tools.name: photos_upload
tools.description: Upload local photos or videos directly into your Proton Photos library.

tools.name: drive_info
tools.description: Get full metadata for a single Proton Drive file or folder, including latest revision details.

tools.name: drive_rename
tools.description: Rename a file or folder in place on Proton Drive, without moving it.
